headers.//: Matched against the REQUEST path, not the rewrite target. The app is loaded at '/', so a rule on '/index.html' alone never applied to real traffic and the shell was cached for an hour -- browsers kept running the previous build after every deploy. Default everything to no-cache, then opt the fingerprinted assets back in below.
Safe to cache forever: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a new build produces new names.
